summary: Research and religion civ. All technology is free but slow, and Scholars capture Sacred Sites early. Elephants make its Castle Age army very tanky.

spikes.label: Early Sacred Sites
spikes.detail: Scholars are available from the Dark Age, so Delhi can claim Sacred Sites for gold very early.
spikes.answer: Contest Sacred Sites in Feudal; kill the Scholars.

spikes.label: Elephants
spikes.detail: Tower Elephants and War Elephants arrive in Castle Age and are hard to kill.
spikes.answer: Spearmen, crossbows and springalds. Don't send archers into elephants.

scout: Scholars moving to Sacred Sites in Feudal
Mosques and Madrasas full of Scholars, which speeds their free research
Infantry building palisades forward, which signals tower or palisade pressure

pairings.why: Free blacksmith upgrades make their Feudal army trade well.
Tanky melee and ranged elephants push through defenses.

winConditions.detail: Hold Sacred Sites for gold or a religious victory.
